import polars as pl


def ejecutar(datos, salida, optimizaciones):
    precio_desc = pl.col("l_extendedprice") * (1 - pl.col("l_discount"))
    (pl.scan_parquet(datos / "lineitem.parquet")
     .with_columns(precio_desc=precio_desc)
     .with_columns(cargo=pl.col("precio_desc") * (1 + pl.col("l_tax")))
     .group_by("l_returnflag", "l_linestatus")
     .agg(sum_qty=pl.col("l_quantity").sum(),
          sum_base_price=pl.col("l_extendedprice").sum(),
          sum_disc_price=pl.col("precio_desc").sum(),
          sum_charge=pl.col("cargo").sum(),
          avg_qty=pl.col("l_quantity").mean(),
          avg_price=pl.col("l_extendedprice").mean(),
          avg_disc=pl.col("l_discount").mean(),
          count_order=pl.len())
     .sort("l_returnflag", "l_linestatus")
     .collect(optimizations=optimizaciones)
     .write_parquet(salida / "resumen_precios.parquet"))

import pandas as pd


def ejecutar(datos, salida, _):
    columnas = ["l_returnflag", "l_linestatus", "l_quantity", "l_extendedprice", "l_discount", "l_tax"]
    df = pd.read_parquet(datos / "lineitem.parquet", columns=columnas)
    df["precio_desc"] = df["l_extendedprice"] * (1 - df["l_discount"])
    df["cargo"] = df["precio_desc"] * (1 + df["l_tax"])
    resumen = (df.groupby(["l_returnflag", "l_linestatus"], as_index=False)
                 .agg(sum_qty=("l_quantity", "sum"),
                      sum_base_price=("l_extendedprice", "sum"),
                      sum_disc_price=("precio_desc", "sum"),
                      sum_charge=("cargo", "sum"),
                      avg_qty=("l_quantity", "mean"),
                      avg_price=("l_extendedprice", "mean"),
                      avg_disc=("l_discount", "mean"),
                      count_order=("l_quantity", "size"))
                 .sort_values(["l_returnflag", "l_linestatus"]))
    resumen.to_parquet(salida / "resumen_precios.parquet", index=False)

COPY (
    SELECT l_returnflag, l_linestatus,
           sum(l_quantity) AS sum_qty,
           sum(l_extendedprice) AS sum_base_price,
           sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS sum_disc_price,
           sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) AS sum_charge,
           avg(l_quantity) AS avg_qty,
           avg(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price,
           avg(l_discount) AS avg_disc,
           count(*) AS count_order
    FROM read_parquet('$datos/lineitem.parquet')
    GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
    ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
) TO '$salida/resumen_precios.parquet' (FORMAT parquet);

def ejecutar(datos, salida, optimizaciones):

import pandas as pd


def ejecutar(datos, salida, _):
    df = pd.read_parquet(datos / "lineitem.parquet",
                         columns=["l_extendedprice", "l_discount", "l_quantity"])
    filtrado = df[df["l_discount"].between(0.05, 0.07) & (df["l_quantity"] < 24)]
    ingreso = (filtrado["l_extendedprice"] * filtrado["l_discount"]).sum()
    pd.DataFrame({"ingreso_total": [ingreso]}).to_parquet(salida / "ingreso_descuento.parquet", index=False)

import polars as pl


def ejecutar(datos, salida, optimizaciones):
    clientes = pl.scan_parquet(datos / "customer.parquet").filter(pl.col("c_mktsegment") == "BUILDING")
    pedidos = pl.scan_parquet(datos / "orders.parquet")
    lineas = pl.scan_parquet(datos / "lineitem.parquet")
    (clientes
     .join(pedidos, left_on="c_custkey", right_on="o_custkey")
     .join(lineas, left_on="o_orderkey", right_on="l_orderkey")
     .group_by("o_orderkey", "o_orderdate", "o_shippriority")
     .agg(total=(pl.col("l_extendedprice") * (1 - pl.col("l_discount"))).sum())
     .sort(["total", "o_orderdate"], descending=[True, False])
     .collect(optimizations=optimizaciones)
     .write_parquet(salida / "ingreso_por_pedido.parquet"))

import pandas as pd


def ejecutar(datos, salida, _):
    clientes = pd.read_parquet(datos / "customer.parquet", columns=["c_custkey", "c_mktsegment"])
    clientes = clientes[clientes["c_mktsegment"] == "BUILDING"]
    pedidos = pd.read_parquet(datos / "orders.parquet",
                              columns=["o_orderkey", "o_custkey", "o_orderdate", "o_shippriority"])
    lineas = pd.read_parquet(datos / "lineitem.parquet",
                             columns=["l_orderkey", "l_extendedprice", "l_discount"])
    unidos = (clientes.merge(pedidos, left_on="c_custkey", right_on="o_custkey")
                      .merge(lineas, left_on="o_orderkey", right_on="l_orderkey"))
    unidos["ingreso"] = unidos["l_extendedprice"] * (1 - unidos["l_discount"])
    resultado = (unidos.groupby(["o_orderkey", "o_orderdate", "o_shippriority"], as_index=False)
                       .agg(total=("ingreso", "sum"))
                       .sort_values(["total", "o_orderdate"], ascending=[False, True]))
    resultado.to_parquet(salida / "ingreso_por_pedido.parquet", index=False)

COPY (
    SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_shippriority,
           sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total
    FROM read_parquet('$datos/customer.parquet') c
    JOIN read_parquet('$datos/orders.parquet') o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN read_parquet('$datos/lineitem.parquet') l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    WHERE c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'
    GROUP BY o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_shippriority
    ORDER BY total DESC, o_orderdate
) TO '$salida/ingreso_por_pedido.parquet' (FORMAT parquet);

import polars as pl


def ejecutar(datos, salida, optimizaciones):
    (pl.scan_parquet(datos / "orders_sucio.parquet")
     .drop_nulls("o_orderpriority")
     .with_columns(pl.col("o_totalprice").fill_null(0))
     .unique()
     .group_by("o_orderpriority")
     .agg(pedidos=pl.len(),
          total=pl.col("o_totalprice").sum(),
          promedio=pl.col("o_totalprice").mean())
     .sort("o_orderpriority")
     .collect(optimizations=optimizaciones)
     .write_parquet(salida / "limpieza_pedidos.parquet"))

import pandas as pd


def ejecutar(datos, salida, _):
    df = pd.read_parquet(datos / "orders_sucio.parquet")
    df = df.dropna(subset=["o_orderpriority"])
    df["o_totalprice"] = df["o_totalprice"].fillna(0)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    resumen = (df.groupby("o_orderpriority", as_index=False)
                 .agg(pedidos=("o_totalprice", "size"),
                      total=("o_totalprice", "sum"),
                      promedio=("o_totalprice", "mean"))
                 .sort_values("o_orderpriority"))
    resumen.to_parquet(salida / "limpieza_pedidos.parquet", index=False)

COPY (
    WITH limpios AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT o_orderkey, o_custkey, o_orderstatus,
               coalesce(o_totalprice, 0) AS o_totalprice,
               o_orderdate, o_orderpriority, o_clerk, o_shippriority
        FROM read_parquet('$datos/orders_sucio.parquet')
        WHERE o_orderpriority IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT o_orderpriority,
           count(*) AS pedidos,
           sum(o_totalprice) AS total,
           avg(o_totalprice) AS promedio
    FROM limpios
    GROUP BY o_orderpriority
    ORDER BY o_orderpriority
) TO '$salida/limpieza_pedidos.parquet' (FORMAT parquet);

import polars as pl


def ejecutar(datos, salida, optimizaciones):
    # Se calcula una vez y se reutiliza para las dos salidas.
    devueltas = (pl.scan_parquet(datos / "lineitem.parquet")
                 .filter(pl.col("l_returnflag") == "R")
                 .collect(optimizations=optimizaciones))
    devueltas.write_parquet(salida / "devoluciones.parquet")
    (devueltas.group_by("l_shipmode")
     .agg(lineas=pl.len(), total=pl.col("l_extendedprice").sum())
     .sort("l_shipmode")
     .write_parquet(salida / "devoluciones_por_envio.parquet"))

import pandas as pd


def ejecutar(datos, salida, _):
    df = pd.read_parquet(datos / "lineitem.parquet")
    devueltas = df[df["l_returnflag"] == "R"]
    devueltas.to_parquet(salida / "devoluciones.parquet", index=False)
    resumen = (devueltas.groupby("l_shipmode", as_index=False)
                        .agg(lineas=("l_extendedprice", "size"), total=("l_extendedprice", "sum"))
                        .sort_values("l_shipmode"))
    resumen.to_parquet(salida / "devoluciones_por_envio.parquet", index=False)
